description: Narrates a script and publishes it as a new episode when rendering finishes (poll read_episode). script is up to 8 parts in order: {text, voice_preset} (text up to 50000 characters) or {silence_ms: 1-10000}. Generated speech is in English, with one female voice (american-female-heart) and one male voice (american-male-puck). Text is read literally; write for listening. Reusing idempotencyKey returns the same episode, even after it has published; a retry never makes a second episode and never charges again. A replay carries episode with the current status, so poll read_episode instead of resubmitting.
name: create_speech_episode
title: Publish narration
